decision.reason: A requested target category is legitimate available input when actually supplied independently of the visibility result. Pallet is a known deployment task constant. YCB metadata category is additional provided/oracle side information, not a model-predicted class, and must be named as such in every comparison. This bounded pilot can test conditional target grounding; it does not establish canonical native-reference visibility or solve same-class ownership.
decision.critical_unresolved: A category is not an instance identity. Correct-category detection boxes can still enclose several instances and an occluder; box-only SAM receives no text/category after the detector.

premise_scope.root_reported_diagnosis: V81 strict C->V 56/56 saved masks overlap another GT instance more than the requested target.
premise_scope.what_it_supports: End-pipeline target ownership is wrong in those selected failures.
premise_scope.what_it_does_not_prove: That every failure is caused by the detector, or that the requested name would fix SAM. No new case/score/mask read was performed for this review.

input_availability_analogy.deployment_pallet: The user task itself supplies the constant word pallet for every image; no test-frame label/mask/name chooser is needed.
input_availability_analogy.SYNTHETIC: Use the same constant pallet for all 235 retained source VAL instances.
input_availability_analogy.YCB_PUBLIC_REAL: Explicit category-provided/oracle benchmark: a frozen obj-ID-to-canonical-name adapter may read only nominal category metadata to produce the supplied request. Grounding performance must not be described as discovering that class from RGB.
input_availability_analogy.transfer_limit: Success with 21 distinct provided YCB names does not show that the single broad category pallet distinguishes multiple pallets, wood variants, virtual native slots, or occluder ownership.

smallest_new_inference_contract.one_new_permitted_request_field: requested_category: one frozen canonical ontology string; caption is requested_category + period.
smallest_new_inference_contract.forward_tensors: Processor RGB/pixelmask plus that supplied request token tensors only. Initial q/rough box enter the unchanged input-only detection association, not detector/SAM query clicks. No IDs, pose, r, GT masks, visibility, or instance-selection GT tensor.
smallest_new_inference_contract.GT_only_provenance: original source/category ID, mapping version, category-origin=provided_metadata_oracle, original input identity, source/split; these are not additional forward features.
smallest_new_inference_contract.unsupported_missing_category: Keep an explicit U/error row; do not silently infer class, try synonyms, or fall back to the V81 all22 caption.
smallest_new_inference_contract.grouping: Detector cache key must be (RGB SHA, exact requested category/caption token IDs), not RGB alone. Different objects in the same image can require different captions. SAM embedding remains reusable by RGB only; preserve one SAM output per associated original target.

frozen_controls_required_before_inputs.cohort: All original 1035 VAL instances (235 SYNTH +800 YCB), same order, original q8/L/box/native convention and source split; do not restrict to the 56 failures, known detected rows, or favorable categories.
frozen_controls_required_before_inputs.ontology: Freeze the exact existing 21 canonical names and constant pallet before mapping instance metadata. No score-driven synonym/color/occluder phrase or wording/chunk search.
frozen_controls_required_before_inputs.detector: Same pinned tiny checkpoint/revision/processor/runtime FP32 settings; fixed .4 box/.3 text thresholds, strict official postprocessing, no NMS/GT mask choice. A single-name caption changes conditioning and token context, so its scores are not calibration-identical to V81 all22.
frozen_controls_required_before_inputs.association: Same max continuous IoU to original input query box, ties detector score then original query ordinal, IoU>=.1, native prompt clipping, every no-match U retained. Never re-rank by a GT class-specific box/mask, mask quality, r, visibility, or IoU to target GT.
frozen_controls_required_before_inputs.SAM: Same frozen base-plus/runtime/precision, box-only, points None, multimaskFalse, strict official binary-F32 conversion and native bool output. Quality is audit-only. Supplied category does not become a hidden SAM mask chooser.
frozen_controls_required_before_inputs.integrity: Fresh separate V82 code/entry/output seals and request/token cache bindings; preserve all V81 artifacts. Validate caption/token ownership on every cached detector result. No V82 source input or run was created by this review.

leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.risk: Nominal category metadata is originally part of source GT.
leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.control: Declare it as provided/oracle side information rather than claim GT-free class inference. Only objID->name is exported; pose/r/masks/visibility/depth/GT box remain quarantined. This is an intentional changed input, not label leakage concealed inside an otherwise identical pipeline.

leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.risk: Wrong same-category instance or box containing target plus occluder.
leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.control: Keep original q-box association and all failures; category alone provides no instance certificate. Do not choose whichever same-class GT instance yields a good mask.

leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.risk: Correct target box but SAM returns an interior occluder/different object.
leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.control: This remains a possible failure because SAM is box-only. Compare saved detection association and mask ownership separately after sealing; do not attribute every outcome to detector category grounding.

leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.risk: Foundation pretraining overlaps public source instances/categories.
leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.control: Overlap is not certified absent by local pinned asset metadata; do not claim a fresh zero-shot or independent real-world generalization test. Repeated source VAL use remains development diagnosis.

leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.risk: Text name availability at deployment differs from YCB oracle.
leakage_and_ambiguity_audit.control: Pallet constant is legitimate for this user goal; YCB per-instance canonical name is an explicitly stronger benchmark. Do not infer real pallet subtype/native ID from YCB naming success.

unchanged_target_and_reporting.metrics: Reuse original all1035 native target-M4 IoU with no-match0 and matched-only mean both shown; source counts and U retained. Keep original reference-primary, separate exact q-pixel C/V, O/invalid, and the same frozen strict535 2x3 C/V/U. Report full denominators and V/C tradeoffs, not only recovered 56 cases.
unchanged_target_and_reporting.comparison_label: V81 all-category-unconditioned request vs V82 supplied-target-category request; neither is a same-input classifier improvement.
unchanged_target_and_reporting.reference_semantics: Pixel visible-mask support and older reference-local support remain different. Known category does not make M4zero semantic external/self absence. Virtual cuboid native references are not required to lie on a physical mesh surface, and q/r/native ordering must not be moved to force that.
unchanged_target_and_reporting.oracle_scope: Do not present mask-at-q as a semantic D/E/S classifier or model upper bound; the previously computed q-M4 diagnostic remains separate.
unchanged_target_and_reporting.admission: No automatic current223 inference, deployment approval, gate relabeling, new training, or full-goal completion follows from this feasibility review.

minimal_recommendation: The separate source-only provided-category pilot is a reasonable bounded next test of target-request conditioning, provided the new input/cache contract is frozen and disclosed. Keep the same full cohort and all U outcomes. Its result should distinguish whether category-conditioned upstream boxes help end-pipeline ownership; it cannot by itself prove instance disambiguation or semantic native-keypoint visibility.
local_modelcard_availability: model_assets contains pinned configs/tokenizer/assets seal; no README/model card body was present locally. No external claim of pretraining disjointness is made.
